description: Attorney David Liu Visits the Orange County Sheriff’s Department (AOCDS) and Donates $5,000 to Support Law Enforcement HeroesOn the morning of May 21, 2026, David Liu, a candidate for California’s 49th Assembly District and a prominent Chinese-American attorney, paid a formal visit to the Association of Orange County Deputy Sheriffs (AOCDS). The visit was made with the strong recommendation and accompaniment of State Assemblymember Philip Chen, incumbent for California’s 59th District.This visit
title: Endorsement from Phillip Chen
